name: nori
description: Nori email client — Electron + Bun (React renderer in web/, Electron/Bun host in electron/)

scripts.dev: bun run dev:web & bun run dev:electron
scripts.dev:electron: bun --cwd electron run build:main && electron electron/dist/main.cjs --dev
scripts.typecheck: bun --cwd web run typecheck && bun --cwd electron run typecheck
scripts.build: bun --cwd web run build && bun --cwd electron run build:main
